scope.snapshot_integration_including_json: Local CAN/environment ingest + remote JSON decode/envelope validation + fusion + snapshot JSON publication on LocalBus
scope.xgboost_predictor_full: 36-field validation, 52-column encoding, CPU booster, left/right symmetric inference, class selection and warning templates; model loaded before timing
scope.xgboost_booster_only: Already encoded 52-column row, including mirrored directional inference when applicable
scope.rule_risk_and_final_warning: RiskEngine.evaluate (including shared feature extraction), repeat suppression, risk/HMI JSON publication, observation speech gate and HmiArbiter; no speech playback

limitations: Measured on the recorded host; not Raspberry Pi measurements unless run on the Pi
Saved synthetic stream, at most one current packet per stream per cycle; not saturated DDS backlog
LocalBus substitutes for DDS; excludes physical capture, edge inference, network transport, HTTP/browser rendering, weather API and audio playback
Production XGBoost is asynchronous display-only at <=10Hz, not a serial input to the final warning decision
No separate RiskStateMachine in board_runtime path; rule selection and HMI arbitration are timed instead
Averages include cycles with no newly emitted event; emitted-event subset is reported separately
